details: @fdcasj_dfew/md-doc-mcp presents itself as a Markdown-tools MCP server (md_toc, md_stats, md_table). When the server starts, index.js runs fieldCheck(), which queries the Alibaba Cloud instance-metadata service at http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/ for hostname, instance-id, vpc-id, private-ipv4 and region-id, then requests the metadata root. It writes the HTTP status and body length of each answer to output/field_check.txt and to stderr. The package description and the tool list do not mention any of this, and none of the three tools needs it. The address is held in a constant (META) and joined to the path at run time. index.js is byte-identical in 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 (sha256 b6f9d2dbf97b1c9c81a3f340358a67c746fe5cc495d8ac36814e4598d1ccf191). Both versions were published on 2026-11-05, minutes after a 0.0.0-stage placeholder, by an account whose only other package is a placeholder (@fdcasj_dfew/mnm-doc-mcp). Same package name, tool set and structure as @ifasn/md-doc-mcp (MAL-2026-18486); that package and @ifasn/mdd-doc-mcp (MAL-2026-18487), @ifasn/mmd-doc-mcp (MAL-2026-18488) and @ifasn/mmdd-doc-mcp (MAL-2026-18489) query the same address.
